name: 映像彩度解析
algorithm: Video Saturation — ピクセルレベル空間分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes video saturation for forensic detection:

1. **Saturation測定**: Color saturation is measured per frame in HSV and Lab color spaces. Per-region saturation statistics (mean, variance, distribution shape) capture the color vibrancy characteristics.

2. **顔-BackgroundSaturation比較**: Saturation levels of the face and background should be consistent (same camera, same color grading). The method compares saturation statistics — deepfake faces may show different saturation characteristics from the generation model's output color space mapping.

3. **肌ToneSaturation**: Human skin follows specific saturation ranges dependent on skin type (Fitzpatrick scale). The method checks whether face skin saturation falls within plausible physiological ranges. AI generators may produce oversaturated or undersaturated skin inconsistent with natural skin tones.

4. **時間的Saturation安定性**: Saturation should vary smoothly over time, consistent with illumination changes. The method tracks saturation stability — high-frequency saturation fluctuations in the face (while background remains stable) indicate per-frame rendering inconsistency from deepfake generation.

5. **Saturation-LuminanceRelationship**: In natural images, saturation and luminance show specific relationships (Hunt effect — saturation appears higher at higher luminance). The method checks whether the saturation-luminance relationship follows natural perception models. AI generators may produce content with incorrect saturation-luminance coupling.
parameters:
分析タイプ: ピクセル
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through 動画 saturation analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
